text: AI assistant can perform any UI action: build automations, draft messages, analyze performance
quote: Your AI can do anything you'd do by clicking or typing in Customer.io. That means you can have it build automations, draft messages, analyze performance, and so on.

text: Official CLI plus 'skills' package teaches AI assistants how to operate it
quote: Install the CLI and the skills that teach your AI assistant to use it

text: Data ingestion via official SDKs or the Pipelines API
quote: To get data into Customer.io, use an SDK or the Pipelines API. This is the API that most of our integrations are based on and likely the API you'll use the most.

text: Broadcasts configured in UI can be triggered programmatically with a single API call
quote: Trigger broadcasts: you'll set up a broadcast in our UI and then trigger it with a single call.

text: Profiles can be deleted or suppressed by sending a specially named track event
quote: if you wanted to delete a profile, you'd send a track event with a name parameter called Delete Person. If you want to suppress a profile, you'd send an event called Suppress Person.

text: Pipelines API supports objects and relationships via a /group endpoint
quote: The Pipelines API natively supports objects and relationships through the /group endpoint.

text: Track API sends real-time customer identification and event data into the workspace
quote: Our Track API provides ways to send real-time customer data to your Customer.io workspace including customer identification and event tracking.

text: Postman collection provided to explore and test the APIs
quote: We've generated a Postman collection to help you get started with our APIs.

text: AI assistant can list all active automations in a workspace
quote: List all active automations in my workspace.

text: API access separates read operations from write/delete so each can be approved independently, enabling least-privilege agent access
quote: Reads are separated from writes and deletes... so you can approve each category independently.

text: Segments page shows live audience groups like Paying Customers or Unsubscribed
quote: If you go to the Segments page, you'll see segments like "Paying Customers", "Have not logged in recently" and "Unsubscribed".

text: Automations can trigger on profile events or on segment membership changes
quote: You can trigger automations when profiles perform events, when they join Segments (e.g. they meet attribute conditions), and so on.

text: Broadcasts send a message to a defined list of recipients at a scheduled time
quote: Broadcasts send a message to a list of recipients. Broadcast messages are queued to send to all the defined recipients at a time you specify.

text: Transactional messaging supports receipts, registration confirmations, password resets, reminders, and shipping updates
quote: Transactional messages are ideal for: Purchase receipts, Registration confirmations, Password resets, Event reminders, Shipping updates

text: AI can generate global design styles for emails
quote: AI-generated global styles

text: AI assistant can draft a welcome email directly in Design Studio
quote: Draft a welcome email in Design Studio.

quote:

text: Multiple delays can be chained together within a single Wait Until automation block
quote: Chain multiple delays together in a single _Wait Until_ block

text: In-app messaging supports multiple mobile apps within the same workspace
quote: Support in-app messages for multiple mobile apps in the same workspace

text: Customer.io AI assistant can be used directly from Slack
quote: Use Customer.io AI in Slack

text: Data can be piped into Customer.io using any preferred third-party tools or sources
quote: you can also use your preferred tools and sources to transit data through Customer.io. It's up to you!
